method: Single-reviewer source revalidation plus the explicitly listed browser tests; no renewed council ballots.

findings.original_title: Playlist date unvalidated: User can write/delete arbitrary *.json via path traversal; short date panics
findings.note: Dates are parsed/canonicalized and write/delete paths use playlist_file_path; old raw path construction is gone.

findings.original_title: Rate limiter runs before RealIpLayer/GrantsLayer: spoofable or shared IP key, authenticated bypass never applies
findings.note: Layer order now identifies the client and user first. client_ip still trusts every private/link-local peer, so LAN clients or a Docker gateway require a separate trust-boundary review.

findings.original_title: Panic in run_channel kills supervisor silently; is_alive stays true, no restart or alarm
findings.note: run_supervised converts a child-task panic to an error; supervisor_loop resets state and retries with backoff. Native aborts remain outside Rust panic recovery.

findings.original_title: process_control busy flag racy (load then store) and not cancellation-safe; client disconnect can wedge channel
findings.note: begin_processing uses compare_exchange and an RAII guard; process_control spawns the command so dropping the request does not drop the command.

findings.original_title: Mid-clip failure writes filler for the whole clip duration, not the remainder
findings.note: play_to_output subtracts played_seconds from the slot before writing fallback; a focused regression test exists.

findings.original_title: Single bad packet (send_packet ?) aborts clip or live session; receive_frame errors not distinguished
findings.note: The FFmpeg send_packet/receive_frame implementation cited by the audit has been replaced by GStreamer. This does not establish damaged-live recovery for every GStreamer decoder.

findings.original_title: Docker/release workflows publish without depending on validate; published feature set never tested
findings.note: Docker and Release now call Validate and publication depends on that job. Validate builds the server feature set, not desktop features.

findings.original_title: Scheduled auto-update restarts container with no on-air guard (opt-in)
findings.note: Opt-in scheduled/automatic updates call install_when_due without consulting active playout. Treat the chosen update time as an interruption window.

findings.original_title: Failed schedule update returns early before invalidate(); ticker keeps stale events
findings.note: The saved event revises the queue and invalidates the ticker before propagating later bookkeeping errors.

findings.original_title: Occurrence marked seen before claim; transient DB error drops it permanently
findings.note: A failed claim removes the seen key and is retried; a database-error regression test exists.

findings.original_title: DST spring-forward silently skips Media events in the gap
findings.note: wall_clock_time moves a nonexistent local time to the end of the DST gap; the old silent skip path was replaced. Repeated-hour live behavior is not proven here.

findings.original_title: Error from a scheduled event tears down and restarts the whole playout
findings.note: The historical reviewers disagreed; media error handling has changed substantially. Exercise scheduled corrupt media and lost live sources before closing the continuity claim.

findings.original_title: Pacing clock never re-anchors after a stall: unthrottled burst catch-up
findings.note: PlayoutClock reanchors after MAX_CATCH_UP or MAX_WAIT rather than sending an unlimited backlog.

findings.original_title: No hardware-encoder fallback; VAAPI device hard-wired
findings.note: Encoder construction is now GStreamer-based. Hardware failure/fallback requires actual GPU devices and output-policy review; no GPU was tested.

findings.original_title: Live reader permits can wedge (2 per input) until process restart; fixed 1s retry
findings.note: The cited FFmpeg live reader/semaphore implementation no longer exists. GStreamer source teardown needs its own fault-injection evidence.

findings.original_title: SCTE-35 injector fails open: one bad sync byte stops all signalling, no return/cancel
findings.note: TsInjector sets failed on invalid TS framing and passes subsequent data through without signaling; control.fail exposes an error, but it does not resynchronize automatically.

findings.original_title: 2FA /auth/verify has no attempt limit or lockout
findings.note: The auth path has an IP rate limit, but verify still returns an invalid-code response without a per-code attempt counter. IP limiting alone is not per-challenge lockout.

findings.original_title: ChannelAdmin can set custom output URL to a local file path
findings.note: Custom-output storage and the GStreamer link builder differ from the original FFmpeg path. No file-output authorization exploit was attempted in this review.

findings.original_title: Console request log records full URIs incl. access/key/uuid secrets
findings.note: Request URI and Referer query values are passed through redact_address for known secret parameters; regression tests exist.

findings.original_title: Playlist import writes user-named file in shared temp dir; no cleanup on error
findings.note: Imports use UUID temporary names, create_new, and remove the temporary file after import or write failure.

findings.original_title: config_global init trigger+insert not atomic, CREATE TRIGGER without IF NOT EXISTS
findings.note: The initialization trigger uses IF NOT EXISTS and the trigger/insert execute in one transaction.

findings.original_title: create_channel_records deferred transaction reads before writing (SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT)
findings.note: Channel creation uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE before reading/writing related records.

findings.original_title: Deleting a channel cascades away its as-run history
findings.note: Channel deletion archives as-run rows with the channel name in the same transaction before cascading deletion.

findings.original_title: No backup/snapshot before migrations or self-update; forward-only migrations
findings.note: Pending migrations now trigger VACUUM INTO backups with retention and tests. Backup failure is logged and migration proceeds; full self-update rollback was not exercised.

findings.original_title: Critical-path test gaps: SCTE-35 integration, DST fall-back, restart, migration upgrade fixtures, 401/403 matrix
findings.note: API authorization tests, scheduler tests and a soak harness now exist. This change adds browser CRUD/persistence evidence; full SCTE-35, DST fall-back and old-schema upgrade coverage still need runtime evidence.

findings.original_title: Container runs as root with no healthcheck or health route
findings.note: GET /health now exists with channel/output-age checks. The runtime Dockerfile still has no USER or HEALTHCHECK instruction.

findings.original_title: Unpinned base images, mixed action majors, untagged watchtower with docker socket
findings.note: Base images remain tag-based; the optional updater image is unversioned and mounts the Docker socket. Its opt-in profile reduces exposure but does not pin it.

findings.original_title: Released-migration immutability not provable (no tags/checksum gate)
findings.note: SQLx migration checksums protect applied databases, but this review did not compare every released tag against current migration files.

findings.original_title: Migration 00003 INNER JOIN copies can drop orphan legacy rows
findings.note: The historical INNER JOIN migration needs an orphaned legacy-data upgrade fixture. Fresh installation does not validate that scenario.

findings.original_title: Graceful shutdown does not drain HTTP/SSE
findings.note: axum::serve is selected against shutdown without with_graceful_shutdown; draining HTTP/SSE is not established.

findings.original_title: Logs rotate daily without a size cap
findings.note: File logs rotate by Age::Day and count retention; no size criterion is configured.

findings.original_title: Manual trigger unbounded/duplicable; plain User may trigger and stop events
findings.note: ScheduleState::trigger pushes into a VecDeque without a queue cap or deduplication. User trigger permissions are a product policy, not independently an authorization bug.

findings.original_title: SSE broadcaster does serial per-client work, no client cap
findings.note: Client sends use try_send and full queues are removed. Per-client status work is still serial and there is no explicit total client cap.

findings.original_title: Role/channel/password changes not applied to live sessions (JWT claims trusted; refresh not revoked)
findings.note: Refresh reloads the user from the DB, but an already-issued access JWT still supplies role/channels until it expires. Immediate revocation on role/password change is not established.

findings.original_title: Setup endpoint unauthenticated until first-run completes; port published on all interfaces
findings.note: First-run setup remains unauthenticated until completion and Compose publishes port 8787 on all interfaces; deployment must protect the initial setup window.

findings.original_title: Playlist load errors swallowed; empty playlist marked as saved
findings.note: getPlaylist exposes loadFailed and save is disabled/guarded after failed loading; the new browser regression verifies stored content is not overwritten.

findings.original_title: Any token-refresh failure (incl. 5xx/network) logs out all tabs
findings.note: refreshToken clears the session for rejected credentials, while temporary failures retain refresh state. Network/5xx multi-tab behavior was reviewed statically, not exercised in this run.

findings.original_title: Modal dialogs lack focus move/trap/restore; Schedule/Live dialogs ignore Escape (WCAG 2.4.3, 2.1.1)
findings.note: useDialogFocus moves/traps/restores focus and handles Escape in the schedule/live/generic dialogs. The new browser test exercises ScheduleDialog; other modal families need separate coverage.
findings.runtime_scope: ScheduleDialog focus, Tab wrapping, Escape and focus restoration only

findings.original_title: <html lang> fixed to 'en' regardless of locale (WCAG 3.1.1)
findings.note: The original audit dismissed this claim. App.vue still computes html lang from the active locale with useHead.

findings.original_title: Destructive buttons hard-code #ff9da0 text: ~2:1 contrast in light theme
findings.note: The destructive UserEditor/SettingsGeneral controls still hard-code #ff9da0. Exact contrast in all rendered themes has not been measured in this revalidation.

findings.original_title: SCTE-35 error and config warning share style; error dot same red as on-air
findings.note: SCTE errors and mismatch warnings still share accent text; on-state now uses bg-ok and errors use a separate red dot. The original claim is only partly current.

findings.original_title: obtainUuid 401 check never fires; failed uuid fetch leaves SSE status stream dead
findings.note: AuthFetchError now exposes status and obtainUuid checks it; transient failures preserve the previous UUID. Long-running reconnect behavior is not covered by the CRUD suite.

findings.original_title: Channel-list failure falls back to fabricated 'Channel 1'
findings.note: getChannelConfig still fabricates a Channel 1 entry after channel-list failure.

findings.original_title: Chunked upload: sibling workers not aborted on chunk failure; retry can race same batch
findings.note: Promise.all rejects on the first chunk worker failure without aborting or awaiting sibling work; sibling workers can keep consuming the queue.

findings.original_title: Concurrent playlist loads unguarded; stale response overwrites state and save snapshot
findings.note: A monotonically increasing loadRequest prevents older playlist responses from replacing the latest state. Concurrency fault injection is not part of this run.

findings.original_title: Media browse store applies stale responses; isLoading reset by first finisher
findings.note: getTree still commits each completed response and clears isLoading without a request generation guard.

findings.original_title: msgAlert overlapping timers hide newer alerts early
findings.note: msgAlert creates independent hide timers without cancelling the previous timer, so an old timer can hide a new message.

findings.original_title: de-DE/ru-RU ~1561 keys missing; pt-BR missing a few keys and has orphan keys
findings.note: The supported locale list is now English and Brazilian Portuguese; the cited de-DE/ru-RU files are gone. Full parity of the current two catalogs was not checked here.

findings.original_title: No unsaved-changes guard on in-app route navigation
findings.note: PlaylistPanel protects beforeunload, but no in-app route-leave confirmation was found in the current router/panel.

findings.original_title: On-air state changes not in live region; error alerts time out in 3-4s (WCAG 4.1.3)
findings.note: Alerts have role=alert, but they remain timed and ordinary on-air status has no live-region marker; the off-air failure badge does have role=status.

findings.original_title: Login password label wraps show/hide button; compound accessible name
findings.note: The password label still wraps the visibility button. The runtime snapshot exposes the input as Password Show password, confirming the compound accessible name.

findings.original_title: Logging error-count pill styled identically to ON AIR badge
findings.note: The log error count and on-air badge still share bg-on-air-soft/text-on-air-text styling, despite separate text labels.

findings.original_title: Live protocol selection #1c1c1c on --live ~3.15:1 in light; timeline live colour differs
findings.note: Protocol and timeline styling changed; exact rendered light-theme contrast and consistent live colors need a visual/a11y pass. No contrast ratio is asserted here.

findings.original_title: On-air/warning colours bypass theme tokens (two reds, yellow vs orange)
findings.note: HeaderMenu and other on-air controls still contain literal warning/error colors outside shared tokens; this is design consistency, not a demonstrated transmission defect.

findings.original_title: Playlist table min-w 760px; actions off-screen on narrow viewports
findings.note: The table still has min-w 640px / md:min-w 760px; narrowTable makes the inline editor sticky, but small-screen action reachability was not tested.

findings.original_title: Arbitrary text sizes; on-air marker at 10px below --text-xs floor
findings.note: Several on-air/timeline markers still explicitly use text-[10px].

findings.original_title: authFetchRaw returns second 401 after refresh without ending session
findings.note: authFetchRaw retries once after refresh and returns the second response without ending the session on a second 401.

findings.original_title: Tokens in localStorage/BroadcastChannel; SSE uuid and access token in URL query
findings.note: Tokens remain in localStorage/BroadcastChannel and bearer-like media/SSE URLs remain part of the design. This is an exposure surface, not proof of an exploit.

findings.original_title: uploadPhoto bypasses authFetch (no refresh/retry); unguarded JSON.parse
findings.note: uploadPhoto still uses XMLHttpRequest without authFetch retry and parses responseText without a catch inside onload.

findings.original_title: Updates poller interval never stopped
findings.note: watchStatus clears a previous interval when starting, but exports no stop/dispose hook for the interval.

findings.original_title: App.vue global listeners never removed; theme localStorage read without try/catch
findings.note: Root listeners still lack teardown. Language storage reads are guarded, but theme access and global listener cleanup remain separate follow-ups.

findings.original_title: 'any' on config payloads and auth responses
findings.note: Config/browse code still has any payloads. This is typing debt, not a demonstrated runtime error.

findings.original_title: No catch-all route
findings.note: The router now redirects /:pathMatch(.*)* to home.

findings.original_title: Role gating only on /configure; operator views ungated client-side
findings.note: The original audit dismissed this as a vulnerability: server authorization is authoritative. The client now also gates graphics/settings subroutes by role.

findings.original_title: Setup redirect check only on home and fails open
findings.note: The setup redirect check still runs only for home and catches fetch failure; the backend setup lock is the real initialization guard.

findings.original_title: UserEditor password-mismatch error not linked to fields
findings.note: UserEditor presents role=alert for errors, but password fields still lack aria-describedby/aria-invalid bindings to the mismatch message.
